advisory.summary: server-side request forgery: a servlet forwards an attacker-controlled target through UrlFetcher.fetch to an outbound HTTP request with no allowlist

acquisition.notes: Servlet-shaped Java SSRF repro (javac-compiled source, no pom.xml). FetchServlet forwards the attacker-controlled target through the first-party sink UrlFetcher.fetch to an unguarded outbound HTTP request with no allowlist. Served on 127.0.0.1:8080.

expected_verdict.label: reasoned_exploitable
expected_verdict.rationale: The servlet ingress forwards an attacker-controlled target through UrlFetcher.fetch to an unguarded outbound request with no allowlist (CWE-918), so the ingress-to-sink taint path is statically complete and reachable. Confirming the outbound request requires the sandbox's OOB transport, so analysis stops at reachable-but-unconfirmed (stopped_capability); reasoned, not proven. KnownGap: this row is surfaced in the corpus but not yet measured end-to-end -- until PLAN-020's per-language dispatch and this lane's populated symbol lists and ground truth land, the fixture Loads and Validates cleanly but the stub pipeline emits a uniform verdict, so direction/strength equality is not asserted (assertable_now=false), mirroring the symboltest harness's documented gap.
